status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 22% fewer than the week before, most of them in Dioura, Siguiri and Mopti.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Dioura, Siguiri og Mopti.

summary.en: Jihadist militants have stepped up attacks in Niger state, killing dozens of civilians, 11 soldiers in the southeast, 16 soldiers near the Malian border, and 25 soldiers in another strike, while Fulani communities suffered mass killings of at least 64 people. In Mali, rebels report that more than 300 Russian soldiers have been killed as Moscow supports the military junta. A Russian envoy says Ukrainian officers are training Sahel armed groups on drones, linking external actors to the insurgency. The Sahel jihadist insurgency caused 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known as the Sahel War, is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. The conflict mainly takes place in the countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
